[{"infoTitle":"What is this Partner Services Network and how does it work? ","infoDescription":"Partner Services Network connects you to various quality service partners who can help you grow your business on Flipkart. You can discover service partners to avail various services like product photography, cataloging, account management, advertising support, sourcing etc. Once you choose a service (based on partner details, work profile, pricing, ratings and reviews) you can contact the service provider by raising a request to the partner. The partner will contact you directly for starting the service. "},{"infoTitle":"Who are the Partners listed under Partner Services Network?","infoDescription":"Partners listed here are third-party service providers selected to provide specific services to Flipkart sellers. Flipkart sellers can negotiate and set their own terms of service delivery with these partners. The responsibility of service delivery and performance is guaranteed by the Partners. Flipkart only acts as a facilitator in connecting the sellers and partners "},{"infoTitle":"Do I need to pay for the services? ","infoDescription":"Yes, it is a paid service. The service partners will charge you based on the services offered to you. From time to time the service partners offer special rates and promotions to our sellers. However, it's the sole discretion of service partners to offer these promotions. Sellers need to pay the service partners directly for the services availed. "},{"infoTitle":"What if I am dissatisfied with the service delivered by the partners?","infoDescription":"Before availing the service you can mutually agree with the service partners on the quality parameters of the service delivery. Please note that these terms of services will be between you and the service provider. If you are unsatisfied with the service, you can reach out to your service partners and ask for redoing the work or refund as per the agreed terms of use. You may reach out to the seller support team and share your feedback with us. We will send your feedback to the service provider who will then take up the issue directly with you."},{"infoTitle":"How are Partner Ratings calculated? ","infoDescription":"On completion of Partner Service each seller has the opportunity to share feedback and rating on the service.
The overall rating for a service is a blended mix individual service ratings.
Overall rating for the partner is an amalgamation of all historic ratings received on individual services.","isNew":true}]
